summary: All 6 step-readiness gate tests are value-based and load-bearing. Pre-fix, onCanvasSteps called persist() unconditionally — every 'not.toHaveBeenCalled()' test would see an update call and fail; both 'filled step' tests would see update called on the first (incomplete) emit so the CalledTimes(1) assertion after the second emit would find 2 calls and fail. Coverage is adequate: 3 distinct required-field step types (MESSAGE/DELAY/ADD_TAG) prove the gate is general, not MESSAGE-only; persistence-proceeds tests verify the gate opens and check the body payload (not count-only); the any-incomplete-blocks-save test covers the mixed-array scenario. The mock id-minting mirrors the real applyResponse→steps.value round-trip — the wireable assertion reads live canvas props after applyResponse fires, so it is meaningful. No existing tests weakened.
